name: Huatu Cendes CO., LTD
summary: Huatu Cendes CO., LTD, an architectural design company, provides nondegree vocational training services and architectural engineering design and related consulting services to state-owned enterprises, private enterprises, multinational corporations and government agencies in China. The company was formerly known as Cendes Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Huatu Cendes CO., LTD in January 2020. Huatu Cendes CO., LTD was founded in 1999 and is based in Chengdu, China. Huatu Cendes CO., LTD operates as a subsidiary of Huatu Hongyang Investment Co., Ltd.
